q0.title: What exactly is BinanceLife • Fortune Comes?
q0.content:
A chain-based meme lucky draw toy created by BinanceLife community enthusiasts (experimental project)
Stake/Lock [BinanceLife] → Get Power (Platform Internal Points) → Use Power to participate in various lucky draws for free, that's it

q1.title: How to play?
q1.content:
• Stake or Lock to get Power
• Choose an event, participate or sponsor
• Wait for the draw, claim rewards
• Everything is simple, as happy as rolling dice!

q2.title: Activity Rules
q2.content:
Each activity has 4 fixed prizes, corresponding to 80% / 10% / 6% / 4% prize distribution (including sponsorship)
After the activity ends, 4 lucky numbers are drawn via Binance VRF, winners claim manually

q3.title: Do you make money? Do you issue tokens?
q3.content:
We don't make money, nor do we issue tokens
The platform takes no cut, no fees, no commission from sponsorship. All sponsorship goes 100% into the prize pool, verifiable on-chain

q4.title: Why do this?
q4.content:
Because we don't want others to say we only stare at "listing on spot" every day
Wanted to find some daily fun for the BinanceLife community, and casually build something
If it succeeds, it belongs to the community; if it fails, I'll shut down and sleep

q5.title: What is Power? Can I sell it?
q5.content: Power is just platform internal points, cannot be traded, transferred, or withdrawn, it's just a lucky draw ticket

q6.title: How do I get Power?
q6.content:
① Stake BinanceLife (Longer time means more power, retrieve anytime)
② Lock BinanceLife directly exchange for Power

q7.title: Is my staked token safe?
q7.content:
Smart contract code is 100% open source, anyone can view and verify
Audited by world-class AI security researchers (Grok/GPT5/DeepSeek), no backdoors, no security vulnerabilities

q8.title: Where does the prize pool money come from? Who can initiate a draw?
q8.content:
Anyone (including you) can:
- Initiate a new draw yourself (Fill amount → Pay → Auto-list on square)
- Or directly "Sponsor/Boost" existing draws, amount added is shown on leaderboard in real-time

q9.title: Does the platform charge fees?
q9.content: A small fee (0.01BNB) is charged for each event creation for Binance VRF on-chain drawing and platform maintenance, also to prevent malicious activities

q10.title: How are winnings distributed? Is it reliable?
q10.content: On-chain Binance VRF is used for drawing (picking winning numbers), smart contracts ensure transparency and fairness of every draw

q11.title: How is the leaderboard ranked?
q11.content:
Sponsor Rank: Whoever puts more money into the pool ranks higher
Winning Rank: Whoever wins more amount ranks higher

q12.title: What if no one plays?
q12.content:
Then treat it as I bought the community a cup of milk tea, losing a few thousand U to shut down and sleep, no big deal
If you don't play I don't lose, if you play I don't earn, as long as everyone is happy

q13.title: If it gets popular, will you secretly take a cut?
q13.content: No, code is fully open source, anyone can verify anytime that every penny went 100% into the prize pool. If I change code to take a cut, the whole net will scold me for three days and I'll be socially dead

q14.title: Can I help you promote?
q14.content:
Of course, I'd love that!
Retweet, show winning screenshots, invite people to draw, or open a prize pool of tens of thousands of U yourself
Platform pays no promotion fees, all voluntary

q15.title: Will it be commercialized later?
q15.content:
No plan for now
If one day the community wants to add some small features, we'll open a community vote, minority obeys majority

q16.title: What if I have other questions?
q16.content:
Directly @ me on X, or find me in the Telegram group
I'm at home taking care of kids, nothing else to do all day
